digest: Today's Hacker News highlights a mix of AI, programming practices, and software updates that reflect ongoing trends in tech. A deep dive into production engineering in Haskell at Mercury is drawing notable attention, signifying the continued interest in functional programming in critical systems. The chatter around VS Code’s controversial ‘Co-Authored-by Copilot’ feature suggests significant backlash regarding AI integration and user control. Meanwhile, articles on overcoming AI-related anxieties and a unique study of Neanderthal behaviors underscore a growing fascination with the interplay of technology and psychology, as well as human history. The focus on UI improvements with Apple's watchOS maps mirrors the endless pursuit of refining user experiences. As Microsoft shares its Windows quality progress, it indicates that even giants are continually addressing software reliability amidst a backdrop of innovation and user concerns.
